title: 第010章 云家找到秦延军第011章 找到了

刘紫嫣看见总裁这么开心，急忙问道：“总裁，是有什么好消息吗？”
“对，我师妹传来消息说小师弟已经到了江海，并且还在龙威集团门前逗留过。”吴莫莉激动的说道。
刚刚说完，又皱起了眉头。
刘紫嫣看见总裁又皱起了眉头，急忙问道：“总裁，你这是怎么了？”
“唉！”
吴茉莉叹了一口气：“知道小师弟来了江海，可是又离开了，现在不知道又去了哪里。”
刘紫嫣作为总裁的秘书长，只好又安慰道：“总裁，您就放心吧！相信他吉人自有天相。”
天阙庄园。
云梦蝶的保镖余清月早早的回来了，一进门，就被柳新梅拦了下来：“清月，你可知道？昨日你不在，梦蝶差点就回不来了。”
“夫人，小姐昨天是出了什么事吗？”余清月问道。
柳新梅又面带笑容的说道：“昨天的事就不说了，今天，你就安排你的属下去寻找一个乞丐，20出头，男子。样貌特征。等一会儿你就问梦蝶吧！找到了一定要好生招待，不可有半点马虎，更不能得罪！知道了吗？”
余清月满脸疑惑的答应道：“是！”然后就向云梦蝶的卧房走去。
当她来到云梦蝶的房间，云梦蝶已经起床，梳洗完毕，正要出门。
“小姐，昨天是出什么事了吗？我不是让人跟着你一起吗？”余清月想要解除自己心中的疑问。
“唉！我的暴力女神，昨天我就想出去一个人清净清净，就没有让他们跟着。结果，遇到了王海成那个纨绔，一路追了我几百公里……”于梦蝶就把昨日发生的事叙述了一遍。
余清月这才把心中的疑惑解开，欣欣然说道：“难怪夫人要我派人出去寻找那名乞丐，原来是这么回事！小姐，我已经打电话通知他们了，给他们的任务就是寻找那名乞丐，小姐，你有没有他的照片？如果有，可以给我吗？这样寻找起来更加的方便！”
云梦蝶有些失落的说道：“昨天的事情发展的太快，我都没有机会给他拍照，连他的联系方式也没有！”
于是，云梦蝶就把秦延军的相貌特征说了一遍，余清月并把这一消息发送到属下的手机上，让他们仔细的在江海范围之内寻找。
此时的秦延军经过一晚上的修炼，昨日的一些思念之情，已经散开。

“该去寻找水叔了，也没有联系方式，只好去龙威集团找大师姐询问！”
想到这里，就向烂尾楼外面走去。
刚走出烂尾楼，走上公路，迎面就有几个染着黄头发，蓝头发的人迎面走来。
“哟！现在都什么年代了？怎么还有乞丐走来走去？”
“兄弟，这就是你见识浅薄了吧？你听说过哪一个朝代没有乞丐？真是见识浅薄！”
“唉！这也不能怪我呀！如今这个社会，像我们一样随便混一混不就有吃喝了吗？还怎么能去当乞丐？”
“啪！”

Liu Ziyan saw the CEO so happy and asked hurriedly: "President, is there any good news?"
"Yes, my junior sister sent news that my junior brother has arrived in Jianghai and even stayed in front of the Longwei Group." Wu Moli said excitedly.
Just after he finished speaking, he frowned again.
Liu Ziyan saw the CEO frowning again and asked hurriedly: "President, what's wrong with you?"
"Alas!"
Wu Moli sighed: "I know that my junior brother came to Jianghai, but left again. Now I don't know where he went."
As the CEO's secretary-general, Liu Ziyan had no choice but to comfort him: "President, don't worry! I believe he has his own destiny."
Tianque Manor.
Yun Mengdie's bodyguard Yu Qingyue came back early. As soon as she entered, she was stopped by Liu Xinmei: "Qingyue, do you know? Mengdie almost couldn't come back when you were not here yesterday."
"Madam, what happened to Miss yesterday?" Yu Qingyue asked.
Liu Xinmei said with a smile again: "I won't talk about what happened yesterday. Today, you will arrange for your subordinates to find a beggar, a man in his early 20s. Appearance and characteristics. You can ask Mengdie later! If you find one, you must treat him well. Don't be careless in the slightest, let alone offend! Do you understand?"
Yu Qingyue agreed with a puzzled face: "Yes!" Then she walked towards Yun Mengdie's bedroom.
When she arrived at Yun Mengdie's room, Yun Mengdie had already gotten up, finished washing up, and was about to go out.
"Miss, what happened yesterday? Didn't I ask someone to follow you?" Yu Qingyue wanted to clear up the doubts in her heart.
"Alas! My violent goddess, yesterday I just wanted to go out and be alone, so I didn't let them follow me. As a result, I met that dude Wang Haicheng and chased me for hundreds of kilometers..." Yu Mengdie recounted what happened yesterday.
Yu Qingyue finally solved the doubts in her heart and said happily: "No wonder Madam asked me to send someone out to find the beggar. So that's what happened! Miss, I have called them to inform them that their task is to find the beggar. Miss, do you have a photo of him? If so, can you give it to me? This will make the search more convenient!"
Yun Mengdie said with some disappointment: "Yesterday's things happened so fast that I didn't even have the chance to take a photo of him, and I didn't even have his contact information!"
Therefore, Yun Mengdie told Qin Yanjun's appearance and characteristics, and Yu Qingyue sent this information to his subordinates' mobile phones, asking them to search carefully within the Jianghai area.
At this time, Qin Yanjun had spent a night practicing, and some of his longing for yesterday had faded away.
"It's time to look for Uncle Shui, and there is no contact information, so I have to go to Longwei Group to ask Senior Sister!"
Thinking of this, I walked outside the unfinished building.
As soon as I walked out of the unfinished building and onto the road, I saw several people with dyed yellow and blue hair walking towards me.
"Hey! What era are we in now? Why are there still beggars walking around?"
"Brother, this is because you have little knowledge, right? Have you ever heard of any dynasty that didn't have beggars? You really have little knowledge!"
"Alas! You can't blame me! In today's society, if you just hang out like us, don't you have food and drink? How can you be a beggar?"
"Crack!"
